title: AIRE tests/.evals/config.json
description: Schema for the eval-framework manifest (common/eval-framework.md Section 1). Validated by V37 in validate-pipeline.{sh,ps1} before a generated pipeline is committed. A LEGACY flat manifest (no roots[], installCommands/coverageCommand/sourcePaths/testPaths as top-level ci keys) is grandfathered by common/eval-framework.md Section 1.1 and is NOT required to pass the roots[] sub-schema below — V37 detects that shape (ci.roots absent) and skips the roots[]-specific rules for it, never failing a pre-existing legacy file.

thresholds.description: The single source for every number a gate enforces (eval-framework.md Section 1). unitTestCoverageMin/disallowedLicenses/maxCyclomaticComplexity are the three V37 cross-references against D5/D6 in ci.gates (Section 4 item 4 of CI-SPLIT-JOBS-PLAN.md).

playwright.description: job-level if: for the playwright-e2e job (CI-SPLIT-JOBS-PLAN.md Section 1) is has_e2e_tests, a directory fact detect-stage-scopes.sh computes — never this enabled flag. enabled/startCommand/readinessUrl/testCommand remain the facts the local gate and CI's own trust-gate step read to know HOW to run Playwright once the directory fact says it SHOULD run. backendStartCommand/backendReadinessUrl are the SAME two facts for a genuinely separate backend process — resolved only when the app is not started by one combined command (a monolith, docker-compose, or a monorepo dev task already covers both under startCommand alone, in which case these stay null).

allOf.description: backendReadinessUrl is required whenever backendStartCommand is set — an unresolved readiness URL for a real backend process is a manifest defect, never left implicit.

rubricVersion.description: V37 cross-field rule: MUST equal architecture.md's own version — the same rule tests/.evals/rubrics/architecture-rubric.json's rubricVersion is checked against.

allOf.description: V30's own rule, restated in schema form: an unresolved manifest must carry an empty roots[].

toolInstallCommands.description: V37 cross-field rule: every entry in tools[] must have a matching key here, and vice versa (CI-SPLIT-JOBS-PLAN.md Section 4, cross-referencing 4.0i.1 P1's declaration-completeness rule).
